subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “Then the radio team added a new part called 'One Good Thing.'”?
options: Every year, students in our school join a speaking contest.
On a small island, students go to school by boat.
The students learned that music is not only something found online.
Students could write down something kind they saw at school.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Every year, students in our school join a speaking contest.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「On a small island, students go to school by boat.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The students learned that music is not only something found online.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Then the radio team added a new part called 'One Good Thing.' Students could write down something kind they saw at school.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
